dialogue.content: （こんにちは）
dialogue.English: (Hello.)

dialogue.content: 今日は宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Thank you in advance for your time today.

dialogue.content: 始めますね
dialogue.English: Let’s get started.

dialogue.content: はい、お願い致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 姑との関係で困っています
dialogue.English: I’m having trouble with my relationship with my mother-in-law.

dialogue.content: お姑さんとのこと、詳しくお聞きしたいので、お名前、性別、ご年齢を出来る範囲で教えてください。
dialogue.English: Regarding your mother-in-law, I'd like to hear more details, so could you please tell me your name, gender, and age, as much as you feel comfortable sharing?

dialogue.content: みか　女　４５歳です
dialogue.English: Mika, female, 45 years old.

dialogue.content: 美香さん、ありがとうございます。お姑さんとの間のどんな事でお困りですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you, Mika. What specifically is troubling you about your relationship with your mother-in-law?

dialogue.content: 姑から口を開けば、人の悪口や不満や自分が可哀そう発言、聞かされて嫌になっています
dialogue.English: Whenever my mother-in-law opens her mouth, I have to listen to her bad-mouthing people, complaining, and talking about how pitiful she is, and I'm getting sick of it.

dialogue.content: それは嫌になりますね。。。それではみかさんまで暗い気持に引きずられそうですね。。。
dialogue.English: That must be really unpleasant... It seems like it could drag you down into a dark mood as well, Mika.

dialogue.content: はい、聞いて終わりならまだしも、
dialogue.English: Yes, if it were just listening and done, that would be one thing, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分以外の人は間違ってると評価したり、急に私に諭すように、自分は困ってない素振りしたり、
dialogue.English: She judges everyone else as being wrong, and suddenly starts lecturing me, acting as if she’s not troubled at all.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 逆に相談に乗ってるみたいな口ぶりに変るんです。
dialogue.English: Then she'll switch to a tone like she's the one giving me advice.

dialogue.content: ことらは、まったく困ってないし、何で？って
dialogue.English: But on my side, I’m not troubled at all, so I’m like, why?

dialogue.content: いつも、そんな感じで、会話するとドロドロしています
dialogue.English: It’s always like that, and our conversations feel messy and draining.

dialogue.content: ↑こちらはの間違いです
dialogue.English: ↑ I meant to write "As for me."

dialogue.content: あ、わかりました。みかさんも巻き込まれて、嫌な気持ちが溜まってしまいそうですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I understand. It sounds like you get dragged into it, and all those unpleasant feelings just build up, Mika.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 因みに一緒にお暮しですか？何年くらい？
dialogue.English: By the way, do you live together? For about how long?

dialogue.content: 同居して２０年くらいです
dialogue.English: We’ve lived together for about 20 years.

dialogue.content: それは、本当に長く忍耐されましたね。。。みかさんの辛抱強さに感服します。
dialogue.English: That is a very long time to have endured... I truly admire your patience.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今まではどんな風に受け流すと言うか、我慢出来ていたんですか？
dialogue.English: How have you been able to brush it off, or rather, put up with it until now?

dialogue.content: 出かけていました
dialogue.English: I would go out.

dialogue.content: 忙しいふりをして。
dialogue.English: I pretended to be busy.

dialogue.content: ああ、なるほど。とても賢い選択だと思います！
dialogue.English: Ah, I see. I think that was a very wise choice!

dialogue.content: それでも干渉がひどかったですが、何とか過ごしてきました
dialogue.English: Her meddling was still bad, but I managed to get by somehow.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、きっとお姑さんがたくさん口出ししていたんでしょうね。想像がつきます。この頃は外出も効果が無いほど、お姑さんの口出しがひどいですか。
dialogue.English: I'm sure. Your mother-in-law must have been interfering a lot. I can imagine. Has her meddling gotten so bad recently that even going out doesn't help?

dialogue.content: コロナで外出は控えているので、、、
dialogue.English: I’ve been refraining from going out because of COVID...

dialogue.content: 口出しがひどいのはマシになったのですが、
dialogue.English: The meddling has actually gotten a bit better, but...

dialogue.content: なるほど、距離を取る方が難しくなりますよね
dialogue.English: I see, so it's become more difficult to get some distance.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい、毎日毎日コロナで死んでしまうとか、
dialogue.English: Yes. Every single day, she says things like she's going to die from COVID, or...

dialogue.content: ああ、ご高齢の方は心配が大きいんですね。
dialogue.English: Ah, older people often feel very anxious.

dialogue.content: 何処も悪くないのに、病院で見て欲しいとか、
dialogue.English: Even though nothing is wrong, she wants to go to the hospital to be examined,

dialogue.content: 実際病院行っても帰されましたし、
dialogue.English: And when we actually went to the hospital, they just sent us home.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、それに付き合う感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. Do you end up going along with that?

dialogue.content: 病院も大変そうなのは報道を見てましたが、かえらされちゃうんですか！
dialogue.English: I've seen on the news how busy the hospitals are, but they really sent you home!

dialogue.content: 精神的に落ち着かない、気が済まない、うるさいので連れて行きました
dialogue.English: She was mentally agitated, wouldn't be satisfied, and was so insistent that I took her.

dialogue.content: どこも悪くないから、帰されたんですよね
dialogue.English: They sent us home because there was nothing wrong with her.

dialogue.content: ああ、なるほど。お体の異常はないんですね、でも心配だけが膨らんで
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. So there's nothing physically wrong, but her anxiety just keeps growing.

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫って言っても、思い込んでるので。連れていく方は、恥ずかしいばかりです
dialogue.English: Yes, even if I say she's fine, she's convinced otherwise. Taking her is just embarrassing for me.

dialogue.content: みかさんは毎日振り回されているお気持ちですよね。疲れてしまうのが自然だと思います！
dialogue.English: You must feel like you're being run ragged every day, Mika. It's natural to feel exhausted!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。話してると気持がドロドロしてきて、自分がおかしいのかなって。
dialogue.English: Thank you. When we talk, my feelings get all murky, and I start to wonder if I’m the one who’s off.

dialogue.content: そんな！
dialogue.English: Not at all!

dialogue.content: 押したり引いたり色々するんですが、
dialogue.English: I try various approaches, sometimes pushing back and sometimes giving in, but...

dialogue.content: 先ず、私のいう事は聞こえていない感じです
dialogue.English: First of all, it feels like she doesn't even hear what I'm saying.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、お姑さんは自分の希望を通すのに必死ですもんね。みかさんの気持ちが落ち着かなくなるのは、当然だし、むしろすごく良くお姑さんに対応されている素敵なお嫁さんだと思います！
dialogue.English: I understand. Your mother-in-law is desperate to get her own way. It's completely natural for you to feel unsettled. In fact, I think you're a wonderful daughter-in-law for handling her so well!

dialogue.content: 押したり引いたり色々とは、優しくしたり、時にははっきり強く言ったりです
dialogue.English: By "pushing and pulling," I mean sometimes I'm gentle, and other times I speak clearly and firmly.

dialogue.content: すごく対応にも工夫されていて、素晴らしいですね。誰にでもできる事ではないと思います。
dialogue.English: You’re putting a lot of thought into how you respond—that’s admirable. Not everyone can do that.

dialogue.content: 今、お姑さんは介護認定などは受けていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Has your mother-in-law been assessed for long-term care certification?

dialogue.content: いえいえ、話が終わらないから、いたし方なく・・。はい、要支援１です。
dialogue.English: No, no, I just do it because she won't stop talking... Yes, she is certified as "Support Level 1."

dialogue.content: なるほど、お口が止まらないんですね。お元気な証拠とは言え、みかさんにはそれだけ負担も増えてしまいますよね。重く感じてしまうのは当然だし、罪悪感のように感じていることはみかさんの優しさだと思います！
dialogue.English: I see, so she's very talkative. While that may be a sign of good health, it also increases the burden on you, doesn't it? It's natural to feel overwhelmed, and I think any guilt you might be feeling is a sign of your own kindness!

dialogue.content: 優しさ。
dialogue.English: Kindness.

dialogue.content: は、必要ないのかなって、思う時もあるのですが。
dialogue.English: Sometimes I wonder if that kindness is even necessary.

dialogue.content: そうですか、少し受け取り方が違っていましたね。すいません。
dialogue.English: I see, it seems I misinterpreted that. I apologize.

dialogue.content: いえ、いえ、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: No, no, it’s alright.

dialogue.content: 長い同居生活で、多少面倒に感じても付き合ってこられたみかさんが、このコロナ禍で外出のような気晴らしもできなくなって
dialogue.English: After all these years of living together and putting up with things even when they were bothersome, you've now lost that outlet of going out because of the pandemic...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: これからまだ、続きそうな生活状況ですから、少しでも気持ちを軽く出来るような方法を見つけたいですよね。。。
dialogue.English: This situation looks like it will continue for a while, so it would be good to find a way to lighten your emotional load, even just a little...

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。優しくしても、しなくても、さほど変わらないって、正直最近思うのです。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. To be honest, I've recently started to feel that it doesn't make much of a difference whether I'm kind to her or not.

dialogue.content: 今一番嫌だなって思うのは、
dialogue.English: The thing that bothers me the most right now is...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: テレビのニュース一緒に見ていて、コロナの予防接種
dialogue.English: When we're watching the news about the COVID vaccinations together...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: とか、お年寄りが一番被害に遭ってるのに、
dialogue.English: like how the elderly are the most affected,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 自分には遅いとか
dialogue.English: she complains that it's too slow for her...

dialogue.content: 給付金が出ないとか、
dialogue.English: that she isn't getting any stimulus money,

dialogue.content: 運動不足で被害者だとか
dialogue.English: that she’s a victim because she’s not getting enough exercise,

dialogue.content: 何でも文句に。。。
dialogue.English: So she turns everything into a complaint...

dialogue.content: 医療従事者への感謝の言葉も、お金が無くて苦しんでる人の事は
dialogue.English: And there’s not a word of gratitude for healthcare workers, or for people suffering financially—

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一切なく、ただひたすら自分自分なんです。
dialogue.English: nothing at all—it's just me, me, me, all the time.

dialogue.content: さりげなく困ってる人の話題にするんですが、
dialogue.English: I try to casually bring up the topic of people who are struggling...

dialogue.content: 素晴らしく、困ってるのは自分。こんなに、恵まれてるのに。ビックリです。
dialogue.English: but, amazingly, she turns it into how she’s the one suffering. She’s so blessed, and yet—I’m shocked.

dialogue.content: ああ、なるほど。
dialogue.English: Ah, I see.

dialogue.content: 自分はもうすぐ死ぬからいいけど、と言いながら。これは、他の事でも言えるんです
dialogue.English: She says things like, ‘It’s fine, I’ll be dead soon anyway.’ And she says this about other things too.

dialogue.content: 食事を大勢でするとき、姑さんはいつも食べないんです
dialogue.English: When we eat with a group, my mother-in-law never eats.

dialogue.content: ああ、発言一つ一つに振り回されますね。。。疲れますよね。。。
dialogue.English: Ah, you get jerked around by every single thing she says... That must be exhausting...

dialogue.content: え、どうして？
dialogue.English: Oh—why is that?

dialogue.content: コロナが心配？
dialogue.English: Is she worried about COVID?

dialogue.content: いえ、食事の時はコロナ以外の時からです。格好つけてるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: No, this has been happening with meals since before COVID. Is she trying to put on airs?

dialogue.content: でも、実は凄く卑しいってのが分かったんです。
dialogue.English: But I realized she’s actually quite greedy.

dialogue.content: どんな事ですか？
dialogue.English: How so?

dialogue.content: 毎日の食事で分かったんです。他人が居ないと美味しいものから一番に食べたり、美味しいものが食べたいって要望が多い。
dialogue.English: I realized it from our daily meals. When other people aren't around, she eats the tastiest things first, and she makes a lot of requests for delicious food.

dialogue.content: 人前では格好をつけたい方なんですね、そんな雰囲気を私も感じます
dialogue.English: It sounds like she wants to keep up appearances in front of others—I get that impression too.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。口では、あそこ行きたい、連れてって欲しい、食べたこと無いって言う割に、行こうって誘うと、あれこれ自分の不調で行けなくて可哀そうぶって、買ってきても喜ばない
dialogue.English: Thank you. She says she wants to go here or there, wants me to take her, that she's never eaten this or that, but when I invite her to go, she makes a big show of being too pitifully unwell to go, and then when I buy something for her, she's not happy.

dialogue.content: 買ってきたもの、何回突き返されたか
dialogue.English: I can't count how many times she's rejected things I've bought for her.

dialogue.content: えええ
dialogue.English: Oh my...

dialogue.content: 満たされない人なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is she someone who can never be satisfied?

dialogue.content: わざわざ突き返されたりしたら、みかさんのお気持ちは傷つきますよね。。。
dialogue.English: When she goes out of her way to reject things, that must really hurt your feelings, Mika...

dialogue.content: ええ、傷つきました。自分の思う事しかして欲しくないんでしょうかね・・
dialogue.English: Yes, it did hurt. Maybe she only wants things done exactly her way...

dialogue.content: どう対応したらいいのでしょう・・
dialogue.English: How should I deal with this...?

dialogue.content: そうですね、子供が駄々をこねるみたいに、みかさんにはわがままいっぱいできると甘えているところもありそうに思いますね。。。
dialogue.English: I see. It seems she may feel she can act selfishly with you, like a child throwing a tantrum, because she feels safe to do so...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 要支援の認定だと、お姑さんがリハビリような施設を利用できるようですが、そういうところは利用されていますか？
dialogue.English: With a Support Level certification, it seems your mother-in-law could use rehab-type day facilities. Is she using anything like that?

dialogue.content: 利用されてましたが、色々文句言ってやめられました。
dialogue.English: She used to, but she complained about various things and quit.

dialogue.content: みかさんが外出できないのであれば、お姑さんを外に出かけていただくように出来ないでしょうか。https://kaigo.homes.co.jp/manual/insurance/youshienyoukaigo/youshien1/
dialogue.English: If you can't go out, perhaps we could find a way for your mother-in-law to go out instead? https://kaigo.homes.co.jp/manual/insurance/youshienyoukaigo/youshien1/

dialogue.content: ああ、文句を。。。
dialogue.English: Ah, the complaints...

dialogue.content: ここまでお話を伺って、今はみかさんに短時間でも自由時間が出来る事が大切だと感じています。
dialogue.English: From what I've heard so far, I feel it's important for you to have some free time, even if it's just for a short while.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。でも、サイト、一読、参考にさせてもらいます。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I’ll read through the site and use it as a reference.

dialogue.content: はい、ご利用いただけるものがあれば、ケアマネさんなどともご相談いただくと良いと思います。パートナーさんやご兄弟があればその方たちにも少し代わっていただけると良いですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, if there are any services she can use, I think it would be good to discuss it with her care manager. If you have a partner or siblings, it would also be good if they could take over for a bit.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今は、ご自身が休まれる事を一番に考えて、みかさんの疲れを癒せること優先にされていいと思います。
dialogue.English: For now, I think it’s best to put your own rest first and prioritize things that can ease your fatigue, Mika.

dialogue.content: 時間が来てしまいました、まだまだ話足りないと思いますが、いつでもいらしてください。お話お聞きしますね。
dialogue.English: Our time is up. I'm sure there's still more you want to talk about, but please feel free to come back anytime. I'll be here to listen.

dialogue.content: はい、今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: 本当にみかさんだからご家族が安心してお暮しだと思います！今度はみかさんが安心できるよう応援しています！ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I truly believe your family is able to live in peace because of you, Mika! Now, I'll be cheering for you to find your own peace of mind! Thank you.

dialogue.content: （ロープレありがとうございました、勉強になりました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play, it was a great learning experience.)
